				every_state = {
					limit = { FNKX_region_AFROEURASIA = yes }
					FNKX_core_or_claim_for_ROOT = yes
				}
			}
			FNKX_formation_rewards = yes
		}

		ai_will_do = {
			factor = 10
		}
	}
